[1] EMULATOR FPS MANAGER & SYNCHRONIZED PROXY ENGINE (version.dll)

  - Prominent 1-click "INSTALL FPS MANAGER" button under AKD AIM OPT.
  - Automatically discovers emulator directories (BlueStacks 5, BlueStacks NXT, MSI 5).
  - Verifies binary uniqueness before replacement:
    * If identical version.dll is already installed: skips replacement safely.
    * If foreign version.dll exists: creates timestamped .bak backup and installs cleanly.
  - Dynamically hooks ucrtbase.dll __stdio_common_vsprintf / __stdio_common_vswprintf.
  - Exact 9 profiles matching AKD PC Settings main tool hotkeys:
    * Profile 0: 60 FPS SYNC (Target: 60 FPS / Cap: 60)
    * Profile 1: 75 FPS FLOW (Target: 75 FPS / Cap: 75)
    * Profile 2: 100 FPS CRISP (Target: 100 FPS / Cap: 100)

    * Profile 4: 144 FPS ESPORTS (Target: 144 FPS / Cap: 144)
    * Profile 5: 165 FPS HYPER (Target: 165 FPS / Cap: 165)
    * Profile 6: 240 FPS PRO (Target: 240 FPS / Cap: 240)
    * Profile 7: 360 FPS ULTRA (Target: 360 FPS / Cap: 360)
    * Profile 8: 999 FPS MAX (Target: 1000 FPS / Cap: 1000)
  - Full bidirectional Studio Sync & Hotkeys:
    * Controlled via main tool hotkeys: [PAGE UP] Next Profile | [PAGE DOWN] Prev Profile | [HOME] Hide Meter.
    * F2 hotkey completely removed to prevent key conflicts.
    * In-game audio chime feedback with frequency dynamically scaling per profile.
  - Dynamic Multiplier with Live Pulse Jitter:
    * Frame-timed pulse and dynamic curve prevent numbers from getting frozen or stuck at 100.

[2] PURE CLOUD GIST AUTHENTICATION & AUTOMATIC PASS-THROUGH
  - Pure Cloud Gist Authorization checked dynamically at injection time.
  - Matches Machine SID, Windows username, and active subscription status.
  - Trial vs VIP distinction:

    * New users receive the global free trial.
    * Full feature access during trial: Customization, Meter Themes, and Injector completely unlocked!
    * If trial has expired or machine is unlicensed: version.dll skips hook loading 100%!
    * Zero memory modification, zero hooks installed, operates strictly as vanilla forwarder.
    * Emulator (HD-Player.exe) continues running 100% vanilla without crashing or hanging.

  - Instant Discord webhook telemetry sent when version.dll loads inside HD-Player.exe.

    * Reports Active Profile and subscription integrity level.
    * Reports trial expiration / defense alerts.
  - Client Webhook:
